persons.name: Ravendradeva
persons.evidence: devamahāvihāre dhivāsinaḥ ācārya sthavira ravendradevasya yatpuṇyaṃ

date.as_written: samvat a 0((8))2 bhādrapadakṛṣṇa trayodaśyāṃ; trayo dhikesītisate gate abde māse jyeṣṭe kṛtakṛṣṇapakṣake aikādaśī somaprasasyasaṃjñake

purpose: merit of Ravendradeva transferred to (guru,) mother, father and all beings
notes: Several dates: (1) NS 182 Bhādrapada kṛṣṇa 13 at end of Mahāmāyūrī (primary copying date, CE 1062); (2) verse date 'trayo'dhike 'śītiśate' = [NS] 183 Jyeṣṭha kṛṣṇa 11, Monday (soma), date of consecration (pratiṣṭhā) of book, image, vajra-ghaṇṭā pairs, Pañcarakṣā and Cakrasaṃvara by Ravendradeva (CE 1063); (3) a further corrupt date 'samvat a 0[(8)]3†5†' in the final donative colophon. Kings conflict: the verse names Śaṅkaradeva as reigning, whereas the prose donative colophon names '(pajuna)kāmadeva', read by the catalogue as Pradyumnakāmadeva; the two reigns are not normally placed together, and Śaṅkaradeva at NS 183 is chronologically doubtful—possibly different layers/dates. Vihāra founded by/named after Mānadeva (place name, not listed as person). No scribe named; Ravendradeva is the donor/consecrator, possibly also owner. 'gurumātāpitā' beneficiaries unnamed.
